whatsNew: A full rebuild: cleaner design, simpler Drive backup, better instruments, and Sona the music buddy. The AI assistant is gone.
changes: New look: new logo and icon, Plus Jakarta Sans and JetBrains Mono fonts, light, dark and match-device themes, five accent colors.
One navigation per screen: tabs on top for desktop, a bottom tab bar on phones and tablets. The slide-out menu and duplicate buttons are gone.

Google Drive backup is now one Back up button. Sign in once and changes sync on their own; every sync merges first, so two devices never overwrite each other. Signing out now clears your name and photo.
Transpose and capo are saved per song and show right away in the Chords view. Capo shows the shapes you actually play.
Chords stay above the right word even when lines wrap on a phone. Inline [G]chords display above the lyrics too.
Editor: chord chips insert chords at the cursor, undo/redo per song, everything autosaves. The demo song no longer overwrites your song.
Circle of fifths redrawn: the key family is highlighted, Roman or Nashville numbers on each wedge, key signature, relative key, and the seven chords of the key to tap and hear.
Piano and fretboard: real chord and scale highlighting, correct sharps and flats for the key (F# in G, not Gb), proper fret inlays, Drop D tuning, press-and-slide playing.
Better sound: plucked-string guitar and bass (tuned to the cent), piano that stops when you let go.
Tuner rebuilt: accurate pitch detection with the microphone's echo cancellation turned off, needle gauge, Hz and cents, nearest-string hint, adjustable A4.
Metronome now keeps steady time on the audio clock, with 2/4 to 12/8, tap tempo and save-to-song.
Stage view: keeps the screen awake, auto-scroll pauses when you touch, arrow keys move through a setlist, three stage colors.
Setlists: reorder songs with up/down, play from the library, share a whole setlist.
Share links keep the song inside the link and no longer go through TinyURL unless you choose to shorten one. Old Sonata links still open.
PDF export keeps accented letters (ñ, é), shows key, capo and tempo, and prints a whole setlist.
Deleting a song can be undone, and deleted songs no longer come back after a Drive sync.
Works offline after the first visit (real service worker). About page now states plainly that Vercel counts anonymous page views.
Removed the Gemini AI co-writer and its server code.
Meet Sona, a blue pixel musician who wanders the bottom of the screen, bobs to the metronome and shares tips. Hide Sona in Settings.
Code rebuilt as small JavaScript modules, type-checked with TypeScript, with unit and browser tests. Your existing songs and settings load unchanged.

whatsNew: Stage Mode Responsive Overhaul, Touch Interaction Hardening, In-Stage Transposition & Setlist Controls, Theory Circle Robustness
changes: Re-engineered Present / Stage Mode top bar and controls layout to eliminate header overlap on all mobile screen sizes (320px–430px) and landscape orientations.
Added active in-stage transposition steppers (♭ / ♯) with real-time key badge updates, allowing musicians to transpose without leaving full screen.
Added on-stage setlist navigation (‹ Prev / Next ›) with counter badge for fluid setlist progression during live performances.
Fixed mobile bottom dock layout collisions by defeating input[type='range'] specificity override, ensuring the auto-scroll speed slider stays compact and within viewports.
Added thumb-pause autoscroll protection and drag vs tap discrimination to prevent accidental mode toggles while scrolling on touch devices.
Fixed Circle of Fifths Roman numeral and Nashville number rendering by ensuring KeyDetector always provides a valid fallback tonic, eliminating '?' glyphs on empty charts.
Scoped the AI Co-Writer floating button to display exclusively on the Editor tab and auto-hide when the drawer opens, preventing touch interference with the Virtual Piano, Fretboard, and Tools.

whatsNew: Enharmonic Key Spelling, Circle of Fifths F# / Gb Precision, Stage Notation Switcher, Roman Slash Bass Degrees & Accessibility Hardening
changes: Fixed Circle of Fifths sharp & enharmonic key family resolution so F# major accurately highlights F#, B, C#, and D#m (and Gb major highlights Gb, Cb, Db, Ebm).
Added full flat/sharp key support in Key Override alongside a persistent ♯ / ♭ Enharmonic Preference toggle in transposition controls.
Preserved active notation tab across Present / Stage Mode and added an on-stage notation switcher (Song, Transposed, Roman, Nashville, Lyrics).
Refined Roman Numeral slash chord bass notes to render as unambiguous scale-degree numerals (e.g. G/B -> I/3, D/F# -> V/7, G/F -> I/b7).
Normalized modal/drawer z-index layering, auto-collapsed the AI Co-Writer drawer when modals open, and added a 15s AbortController timeout with retry UI.
Hardened mobile split-editor switching, WCAG AA dark-mode contrast, Escape key dismissal, and ARIA roles/labels across tabs, piano keys, and Circle of Fifths wedges.
Google Drive Sync now detects local file previews and directs users to the published HTTPS Sonata site before attempting OAuth.
This prevents Google’s misleading Error 400 authorization screen when Sonata is opened directly from disk or inside an unsupported embedded browser.
whatsNew: Drive Sync now starts only from a valid web origin.

changes: Corrected the 1.5.1 desktop layout: Virtual Piano, full-width Fretboard, and Reference Tuner are now separate rows so the complete guitar neck stays usable.
Reduced the desktop Circle of Fifths to a contained reference size, while retaining its readable controls and mobile-safe layout.
Repaired Google Drive sign-in handling by removing duplicate OAuth click requests and showing Google account selection on a new connection.
Sidebar navigation now closes after a destination is chosen, leaving the selected workspace unobstructed.
Removed interface click sounds and added output limiting plus gentler Circle chord levels to prevent harsh or clipped playback.
whatsNew: A corrective release focused on dependable Drive sign-in, responsive instrument space, quieter controls, and safe audio levels.

changes: Standardized the desktop Play workspace: Virtual Piano and Fretboard now sit side by side, so both instruments are visible immediately instead of being buried in a long vertical stack.
Improved instrument card spacing, sizing, and horizontal scroll treatment while retaining piano, fretboard, tuner, key highlighting, and tuning controls.
Expanded the Circle of Fifths into a larger desktop reference layout with controls placed beside it for easier reading.
Restored desktop access to the full sidebar menu, including Settings, About Sonata, language, sync, presentation, and install actions.
Fixed view isolation so each Sonata workspace displays only its active page.
whatsNew: A cleaner desktop workspace: larger theory reference, visible instruments, and complete navigation from every screen.

changes: Responsive Layout: Tablet & mobile navigation collapse under 1024px into a slide-out drawer, with a dedicated mobile Google Sync status pill.
Desktop & Laptop Full Viewport IDE: Split editor and preview panes stretch to fill 100% of the viewport height with zero wasted space and independent internal scrolling.
Interactive Syntax Quick-Start: Clickable syntax chips in empty editor to quickly insert headers, chords, dividers, and rehearsal notes with instant preview.
Metadata Chips: Replaced plain text author/arranger/key bar with sleek, formatted metadata tag chips.
Live Status Indicator: Dynamic status badge with a live dot reflecting Saved (green), Autosaving (pulsing blue), and Editing (amber) states.
Chart Preview Polish: Fixed text wrapping in chart empty state, replaced plain emoji with modern SVG illustrations, and added thin custom desktop scrollbars.
Destructive Action Confirmations: Safe modal dialogs before deleting songs, loading demos, or clearing unsaved charts.
Unsaved Changes Guard: Browser beforeunload warning and in-app navigation dialog (Save & Leave, Discard, Cancel) preventing accidental loss of work.
Toast Notification System: Modern, non-blocking bottom-center toast alerts for save, cloud sync, export, transposition, and song deletion.
Stage Presentation Polish: Floating, high-visibility 'Exit Presentation' button with 3-second auto-fade, plus keyboard shortcut hints.
Mobile Transpose Stepper: Intuitive minus/plus stepper controls for mobile screens alongside the transpose slider.

Accessibility & Contrast (WCAG AA): High-contrast active tab styling in dark mode, visible keyboard focus rings, descriptive ARIA labels across all icon buttons, and 44px minimum touch targets on metronome controls.
Transpose Undo Stack: Integrated chord transposition into the 50-step undo/redo history stack.
Cross-Platform Shortcut Hints: Dynamically detects macOS (⌘S, ⌘Z) vs Windows/Linux (Ctrl+S, Ctrl+Z) for keyboard shortcuts, with a global Cmd/Ctrl+S save listener.
whatsNew: Comprehensive UI/UX overhaul: desktop & laptop full-height split IDE, interactive syntax quick-start, metadata chips, live status badge, unsaved changes protection, destructive action modals, and mobile responsive navigation.

changes: AI Action UI: Actions now securely execute UI commands with a new 'Undo' functionality.
Inline UI Confirmations: Safely clear your AI chat history without disruptive browser popups.
Smarter Gemini: The AI Co-Writer now perfectly understands all Sonata app features, settings, and navigation.
AI UX Polish: Modern Bot icon replaced the generic stars, and settings bugs were fixed.
whatsNew: AI UI bugfixes, 'Undo' AI actions, and a smarter Co-Writer system prompt.

changes: AI Co-Writer: Generate chords, format lyrics, and automate the UI directly via chat.
Bring Your Own Key (BYOK): Add your own free Google Gemini API key for unlimited AI access.
AI Settings UI: Easily manage your AI API key and fallback settings.
Enhanced About Sonata page with feature accordions and updated UI.
whatsNew: AI Co-Writer with BYOK support and automated UI controls.

Enhanced responsive design for tablet, desktop, and mobile viewports.
